outcome: Infant death due to congenital anomalies
cohort: 2199 women referring health centers of nine provinces of Iran 2015-2018
finding: History of cesarean delivery, maternal age, area of living, maternal smoking during pregnancy, consanguineous marriage, and low birth weight were significantly associated with infant death due to congenital anomalies.
mod_finding: History of cesarean delivery was significantly associated with infant death due to congenital anomalies.
